runs.detail: Opcode 0x5f was UNKNOWN, so the dispatcher did not resolve regular functions.
Panoramix produced 9,550 assembly lines and found 20 selectors, but every per-function call hit the tool's POSIX-only SIGALRM path on Windows.
The first symbolic function did not converge after more than five minutes. No new completed output replaced the archived prior-stage files.
The target symbolic execution did not converge after more than four minutes; observed working set reached 5,792,555,008 bytes.

outputs.description: Complete Panoramix disassembly, 9,550 lines. The nine remaining UNKNOWN bytes are in the Solidity metadata tail after executable code.

conclusion: Panoramix successfully disassembled the full attack-time runtime and recovered its dispatcher selectors, including 0x2818300e, but it did not produce converged high-level pseudocode for that selector.
evidence_boundary: These files are tool output, not verified Solidity source. They do not establish equivalence to the archived XDC Solidity, reconstruct historical storage, or prove the full exploit path by themselves.
